canonical_project: Digital Realty Crawley LON5 (Rackspace) data centre

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Operational wholesale colocation at Unit 1 Power Avenue, Crawley (Manor Royal); launched Apr 2015 with four data suites, 130,000 sq ft and ~10MW; Colo-X lists the campus first building as 12MW with four data halls. West Sussex county division includes Crawley borough LPA.
